prefLabel.en: Applicable laws and regulations (laws, contracts, funder requirements, policies, guidelines, combined/aligned with the EU Common Open Data Platform, ECHA, Horizon Europe, OECD, Science Europe)
prefLabel.nl: Toepasselijke wet- en regelgeving (wetten, contracten, eisen van financiers, beleid en richtlijnen, gecombineerd met of afgestemd op het gemeenschappelijke opendataplatform van de EU, ECHA, Horizon Europe, OESO en Science Europe)

definition.en: The specific external and internal requirements with which a data policy is aligned, including legislation, contracts, funder conditions, policies, guidelines, and relevant European or international frameworks.
definition.nl: De specifieke externe en interne vereisten waarop een databeleid is afgestemd, waaronder wetgeving, contracten, voorwaarden van financiers, beleid, richtlijnen en relevante Europese of internationale kaders.

en: Use for policies, requirements or practices specifically concerning applicable laws and regulations (laws, contracts, funder requirements, policies, guidelines, combined/aligned with the eu common open data platform, echa, horizon europe, oecd, science europe). Use the broader concept for statements that do not distinguish this specific aspect.
